No one responded.

Tau takes out pens from his suitcase for each side to sign with.
[i]Each sides representatives must sign the signatory part of each folder.[/i]
He points to the part of the last paper were the Alkiragunya needs to sign, with more then enough space for all of them.
[i]You can sign with either your name or a symbol that represents you, or even a stamp that is recogniced by your people, we have ink of several colors if you need it.[/i]
He presents one of the folders to the Nordiheimian representatives.
[i]I tink the Nordiheimian representatives can do theres first to provide an example for you.[/i]

[i]Thats not a bad idea.[/i] Says Siggurd as he does his signature, it is rather fancy and refined.

Next is Omeo with a simpel and practical style.

Then Jiemba with a precise and exact signature.

Final its High priest Warus turn, he signs slightly differently, while he starts with 'Waru', he then takes out an amulet from his robe that he removes part of, revealing some sort of shape that is hard to see, he then carefully dips it in some sand-brown ink provided by Tau before stamping the shape down on the paper beside his first name firmly yet carefully, when he lifts the amulet there is left an artistic shape of some sort of draconic looking lizard.

Having let the Alkiragunya see how it is done more or less, Tau then motions for the Alkiragunyas to do there 'signatures'.

[i]O conselho assinará com sua assinatura típica.[/i]
Balunji diz, então os outros conselheiros se viram de costas e ficam em um círculo, murmuram coisas inaudíveis enquanto põem as mãos sobre as de cada um .... após esse processo, Balunji se levanta e vira em direção ao papel e com a ponta do dedo, que parecia brilhar em um tom arco íris trocando de cor.
[i]Wana, o arco íris, o símbolo do conselho, representa um novo ciclo já que o mesmo apenas aparece após o fim de chuvas, que marcam o fim da estação seca e começo da estação chuvosa, e aqui marca uma passagem de um novo ciclo em que nos abrimos sou comércio exterior.[/i]
Balunji explica enquanto põem o dedo no local de assinatura , que fica brilhando no mesmo jeito qur seu dedo estava anteriormente.
[i]Agora isso recebe a benção de Wonambi, considere esse acordo e papel oficialmente....sagrados, é o mais próximo de seus termos estrangeiros.[/i]
[i]The council will sign with our typical signature.[/i]
Balunji says, then the other councilors turn their backs and stand in a circle, mumbling inaudible things while placing their hands on each other's... after this process, Balunji stands up and turns towards the paper and with the tip of his finger, which seemed to shine in a rainbow tone changing colors.
[i]Wana, the rainbow, the symbol of the council, represents a new cycle since it only appears after the end of the rains, which mark the end of the dry season and the beginning of the rainy season, and here it marks a passage of a new cycle in which we open up foreign trade.[/i]
Balunji explains as they place their finger on the signature spot, which remains shining in the same way as his finger was previously.
[i]Now this receives Wonambi's blessing, consider this agreement and paper officially.... sacred, it is the closest to its foreign terms.[/i]
So how did Christianity become a thing in Erene and what is English in erene called?

The Nordiheimians look at this "signing" with suprice and a bit of wonder, Omeo wispers a barrly audible "[i]Spirit magic?[/i]", the only exeption is Waru, who dosent seem to supriced by this, he gives a nod to the others who seem to take that as a sign that this odd happening should be accepted.

[i]Well, that certainly should make it pretty forgey proof[/i] Quips Omeo

Hello, I'm mostly new to this site but have spent the better part of the last few hours acquainting myself.  I'm working through the requirements as we speak so forgive me if I take a while to respond.

I am mildly familiar with general roleplay and moderately familiar with worldbuilding.  I chose this one because you guys honestly had the most consistent maps and roleplay guidance.

My current nation I'm hoping to RP on the "2000" map is a fairly insular federation of essentially city-state communes in the mountains who have had a rough time since the pre-industrial era with infighting and abusive resource extraction, right up until several things came to a head at once that drove out just about anyone who wasn't willing to give it up despite it being made next to uninhabitable.  While the "modern day" version promises to be more of a "mildly balkanized Switzerland(?) sticking together out of shared trauma", I'm still working on a rather scandalous hidden history and piecing together a unique governing system that hopefully won't sound too unrealistic while approaching things from a new angle.
